t: Founded when Stephen I was crowned in 1000 or 1001, it brought the Magyars into Latin Christendom.
Royal counties, a Latin church and the union with Croatia in 1102 made it a major power of central Europe.
The Mongols devastated it in 1241; after rebuilding, baronial power grew until the Árpád male line ended in 1301.
dyk: The Golden Bull of 1222, issued seven years after England's Magna Carta, allowed the nobles to resist a king who broke its terms.
ev: Stephen I is crowned the first king of Hungary
Emperor Conrad II's invasion of Hungary fails
Coloman is crowned king of Croatia, uniting the two crowns
Andrew II issues the Golden Bull, limiting royal power
The Mongols destroy the royal army at the Battle of Mohi
Hungarian troops help Rudolf of Habsburg defeat Ottokar II on the Marchfeld
Andrew III dies, ending the Árpád male line
